Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [You have the worst customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a0df3546666c0881f837d92)
You have the worst customer service. My order was placed on April 27 and was suppose to be delivered on May 8. On May 7 I was told it is late and would be delivered the following week. I then was told it is delayed again and got it today on May 20 with supposed white glove delivery. I was told they remove my old rug and place the new one and they DID NOT. Then they would not touch the furniture to align the rug and said they are not supposed when I was specifically told they would set it all up. Horrible experience as a first time shopper. I will NEVER been shopping from @luluandgeorgia again and will be telling my network.

May 3, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 20, 2026

Hi there,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced due to the delays in your oversized rug shipment. I understand how frustrating this must be. Please note that while our White Glove delivery service includes set-up for your new rug, it does not cover the movement or removal of existing furniture. If you have any further questions or need assistance, please let us know, we are happy to help!

Lulu and Georgia
